name: Seasoned Gaming
description: Seasoned Gaming is an independent games publication founded by Ainsley Bowden, covering games across platforms through news, reviews, features and the Bitcast podcast.

name: Sega Saturn Shiro
description: SEGA Saturn SHIRO! covers the Sega Saturn and its enthusiast community, including game retrospectives, fan translations, homebrew projects, technical discoveries and podcasts.

name: Seven Out of Ten
description: Writing about video games from Seven Out of Ten

name: Short Musings about Short Video Games
description: Lucy Yearwood writes personal reflections on the games she enjoys, with a particular interest in short independent games, unusual small releases and Metroidvanias.

name: Sibylle Writes Games
description: Site no longer exists

name: SideQuest
description: Sidequest publishes criticism, personal essays and creative work about games and gaming culture, centering writers of marginalized genders. Its contributors discuss both video games and tabletop roleplaying.

name: Sidequesting
description: SideQuesting covers video games and the culture around playing them through reviews, personal articles and podcast conversations, with occasional coverage of adjacent entertainment.

name: Signals and Light
description: Video essays analyzing game design, narrative, and media.

name: Simonschreibt
description: Writing about video games from Simonschreibt

name: Skill Issue
description: Skill Issue is a personal publication sharing enthusiasm and reflections on video games of different kinds, including overlooked and underrated titles.

name: SomeSelectedStories
description: SomeSelectedStories aggregates news about the mobile gaming landscape and also publishes its own gaming content.

name: Sonoran Videogame Society
description: Site no longer exists

name: Stay Awhile and Play
description: Stay Awhile and Play publishes independent features on games, gaming culture and the industry, with a particular interest in play and mental health. It also hosts interviews with developers and other games professionals.

name: Stevivor
description: Stevivor is an independent video games outlet that has serviced Australia, New Zealand and the world since 2009

name: Super Combo
description: The home of competitive fighting games. Breaking News, Tournament Coverage, Community Wikis, Forums and much more for the FGC

name: Super Phillip Central
description: SuperPhillip Central publishes video game reviews and editorials covering contemporary and older games, alongside features about game music.

name: SuperJoost Playlist
description: Joost van Dreunen analyzes the business of play, covering video games, toys, tabletop gaming and the companies and technologies connecting them. His writing includes financial analysis, market data and business strategy.

name: Superjump Magazine
description: SUPERJUMP is a video game magazine publishing in-depth features, opinions and reviews of independent and AAA games, with an emphasis on the experiences and creative work behind them.

name: Supper Mario Broth
description: Not an actual blog

name: Survival Horrors
description: Survival Horrors documents survival horror games through a genre database, historical timeline and coverage of upcoming releases, with particular interest in independent developers. It also offers tools for tracking played games and backlogs.

name: Sushiball Games
description: Sushiball Games is a husband-and-wife board game review site covering both published games and projects at the Kickstarter stage.

name: TYPEDBYTOM
description: Tom writes personal essays and playthrough-style reflections on video games alongside work about photography. TYPEDBYTOM also explores photography within virtual worlds, game soundtracks and interviews with creative practitioners.

name: Tagowill
description: TagoWill documents the development of an original game, drawing on the author's experience building virtual reality projects in Unreal Engine.

name: Tentacular Games
description: We are an indie dev team founded by internationally recognized Narrative Designer, Nick Jones. By subscribing you receive regular in-depth essays on the craft of Narrative Design as well as short stories and updates on the development of our exciting new transmedia franchise.

name: That Gaming Feeling
description: Brothers Nick and Nicshel write personal reflections on the games they grew up with and the games they play, exploring memories, connections and feelings rather than chasing news or review scores.

name: The Adventurers Guild
description: The Adventurers Guild publishes contributor-written playthroughs and assessments of older computer adventure games, discussing their puzzles, stories and practical quirks.

name: The Alinea Insight newsletter
description: Alinea Analytics shares analysis of the video game market using estimated sales, revenue, player engagement and pre-launch interest data. The newsletter examines market trends and game performance for readers interested in the games business.

name: The Arcade Artificer
description: Game director JB Oger analyzes how game design entertains players, using close examination of games to share ideas and lessons with other creators.

name: The Arcade Blogger
description: Writing about video games from The Arcade Blogger

name: The Besties
description: The Besties accompanies the video game podcast by Griffin McElroy, Justin McElroy, Chris Plante and Russ Frushtick, who discuss, rank and review games. Its newsletter provides links to games discussed on the show and supplementary material.

name: The Boss Level
description: Marcio Campassi uses games and storytelling to explore leadership, project delivery and creativity. The Boss Level connects fictional characters and game experiences with professional and personal decision-making.

name: The Bottom Feeder
description: Jeff Vogel writes opinionated essays about computer games and related technology and cultural questions, mixing games commentary with broader personal arguments.

name: The Cloud Gaming Newsletter
description: The Cloud Gaming Newsletter shares a player's perspective on video game news, releases and industry developments, alongside game reviews and retrospective writing.

name: The Code Deposit
description: Game tech musings from the past and present

name: The Color and Shape of Play
description: Wandyr examines game and level design, focusing on how mechanics, spaces, teaching, exploration and difficulty shape play. The publication combines close design analyses with informal observations about games.

name: The Danger Zone
description: Lead Rendering Programmer at Sony Santa Monica Studio. Formerly Engine Lead at Ready At Dawn Studios. Chief Graphics Meme Officer for the entire internet.

name: The Desk of Chaos
description: The Desk of Chaos publishes video game reviews and personal commentary alongside writing about comics, toys and everyday life.

name: The Digital Antiquarian
description: The Digital Antiquarian chronicles the history of interactive entertainment and digital culture through long-form articles about computer games, their creators and the surrounding industry.

name: The Dreamcast Junkyard
description: The Dreamcast Junkyard covers Sega's Dreamcast and its continuing enthusiast scene, including games, fan projects, translations and restored online play.

name: The Frak Shack
description: Josh, also known as Frakattack, writes personal musings about video games and music, drawing on his interests as a player, writer and Twitch streamer.

name: The Fudge Retort
description: James Fudge writes about esports, the games industry and related sectors, including the people working in those businesses.

name: The Future Friends Games Newsletter
description: Future Friends Games shares news about the independent games it promotes and publishes, the developers it works with and the people behind the company.

name: The Game Business
description: Led by Christopher Dring, The Game Business reports on the video game industry through business analysis, market data and interviews with industry leaders. Its coverage spans publishing, development, distribution and changing player behavior.

name: The Game Discover Co
description: Simon Carless and his GameDiscoverCo colleagues analyze how players discover and buy PC and console games. Their newsletter combines market data, platform analysis and case studies about game visibility and commercial performance.

name: The Game Enjoyer
description: The Game Enjoyer is an independent games publication based in Iceland, publishing reviews, game-design essays and personal writing with an emphasis on enthusiasm for games. It also covers games industry news.

name: The Game Maker's Desk
description: A blog all about game design and the life of a game designer, by Matthew Dunstan

name: The Gamer Educator
description: Teacher and librarian Ash Brandin helps families understand and manage children's screen time, using games and digital media to discuss parenting, learning and different ways of thinking.

name: The Gaming Companion
description: Sisters Rowan and Nimthiriel share beginner-friendly gaming tips, guides and news, with interests spanning cozy games, survival crafting and horror. The Gaming Companion accompanies their broader video and podcast work.

name: The Gita Zone
description: Writing about video games from The Gita Zone
